Specification: This module specifies an internal memory component that interacts with an external memory interface through request and reply actions. It models a small protocol in which each process moves through control states "rdy", "busy", and "done", stores either requests or returned values in a per-process buffer, and updates the memory state on write requests while returning a memory value on reads. The specification defines an initial condition, a next-state relation over per-process actions, a temporal specification using a stuttering-closed box action, and proves that the type invariant always holds.
